scope: Read-only installed Gemini source review and selected non-secret incident metadata; no host launched, settings changed, rollback, or credential contents inspected by this reviewer.

updater.limitation: A failed update and unchanged selected entry/package hashes do not establish whole-install immutability or absence of cache/log changes. This review did not establish a pre-run whole-tree baseline.

pretrustGuard.cause: mergeSettings omits workspace settings until trusted, while interactive startup starts checkForUpdates before trust approval.
pretrustGuard.notificationFlagEffect: An admitted pretrust false value returns before registry lookup; enableAutoUpdate=false alone prevents only installer spawn.

taskLocalSystemDefaults.precedence: schema defaults, system defaults, user, trusted workspace, system settings
taskLocalSystemDefaults.reason: This installed version requires system settings/defaults files and all ancestor directories to be root-owned and not group/world writable on POSIX. A task-owned file is skipped.

alternativesNotRun: IS_BINARY=true suppresses installer selection but changes launcher argument/relaunch semantics; not recommended for npm-host conformance.
A genuine sandbox profile prevents installer spawn but still permits registry lookup and changes host mode; not validated here.
pretrustGuard.recommendation: Keep Gemini actual MCP discovery/tool/image/consent/reconnect/cancellation unverified. Do not repeat interactive startup under the same workspace-only update guards. A future run needs an authorized admitted pretrust guard and supported authentication.

screenReader.comparisonLimitation: This compares current state with its current backup, not a pre-run baseline. No state values are recorded.
